memories.text: I stand under the shop canopy on the main street. The pawn shop is nearby.
There is a warehouse district not far from the shops.
Dufus is the friendly fool who wanders the street. He is wearing his hat but keeps asking about it.
I woke up away from the truck on Day 1 and need to get back to my stand.
Woke under the shop canopy on main street at 08:00, away from the truck and heading back.
At 08:02 on Day 1, I was away from the truck near the shop canopy on main street and headed back toward my stand.
I was at the shop canopy on main street away from the truck, and I need to keep heading back to my vegetable truck.
I was still away from the truck at 08:09 and kept heading back from the main street canopy toward my stand.
At 08:14 on Day 1, I was still walking back toward my vegetable truck from the main street canopy.
I am on main street away from the truck and moving back toward my vegetable stand.
Still on main street away from the vegetable truck at 08:18 and continuing back toward my stand.
Still on main street at 08:20, away from the truck and moving back toward my vegetable stand.
Woke at motel area on main street, Day 1 at 08:00—need to get back to truck.
Woke at motel area on main street Day 1 at 08:00, heading back to truck in the forward-left direction.
Woke at motel area Day 1 08:00, heading toward vegetable truck.
